@startuml
title SƠ ĐỒ LỚP CHI TIẾT - HỆ THỐNG CIV-05

top to bottom direction
skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam defaultFontName Arial
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
skinparam nodesep 35
skinparam ranksep 45
hide circle

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor white
 BorderColor #555555
 ArrowColor #333333
}

'========================
' 1. NHOM NGUOI DUNG
'========================
class NguoiDung {
 maTaiKhoan: String
 tenDangNhap: String
 matKhau: String
 email: String
 soDienThoai: String
 vaiTro: String
 trangThai: Boolean
 --
 dangNhap(): Boolean
 dangXuat(): void
 doiMatKhau(): void
}

class CuDan {
 maCuDan: String
 hoTen: String
 diaChi: String
 --
 dangKyPhuongTien(): void
 xemGiayPhep(): void
 xemViPham(): void
}

class BanQuanLy {
 maNhanVien: String
 hoTen: String
 chucVu: String
 --
 thietLapHanNgach(): void
 xetDuyetGiayPhep(): void
 xuLyViPham(): void
 xuatBaoCao(): void
}

class BaoVe {
 maBaoVe: String
 hoTen: String
 caTruc: String
 --
 traCuuPhuongTien(): void
 ghiNhanVaoRa(): void
 lapBienBan(): void
}

'========================
' 2. NHOM QUAN LY XE
'========================
class CanHo {
 maCanHo: String
 toaNha: String
 chuHo: String
 soDienThoai: String
 hanNgachOto: int
 hanNgachXeMay: int
 --
 kiemTraHanNgach(): Boolean
 capNhatHanNgach(): void
}

class PhuongTien {
 bienSo: String
 loaiXe: String
 nhanHieu: String
 mauSon: String
 anhGiayTo: String
 trangThaiDuyet: String
 --
 capNhatThongTin(): void
 layThongTin(): void
}

class KhuVucDo {
 maKhuVuc: String
 tenKhuVuc: String
 loaiXeChoPhep: String
 sucChuaToiDa: int
 sucChuaHienTai: int
 --
 kiemTraChoTrong(): Boolean
 capNhatSucChua(): void
}

class GiayPhepDoXe {
 maGiayPhep: String
 ngayCap: Date
 hanSuDung: Date
 trangThai: String
 --
 kiemTraHopLe(): Boolean
 khoaGiayPhep(): void
}

'========================
' 3. NHOM THEO DOI HOAT DONG
'========================
class LichSuRaVao {
 maGiaoDich: String
 thoiGian: DateTime
 congRaVao: String
 loaiGiaoDich: String
 hinhAnhCamera: String
 --
 ghiNhan(): void
}

class ViPham {
 maViPham: String
 thoiGian: DateTime
 loaiLoi: String
 hinhAnh: String
 tienPhat: decimal
 trangThai: String
 --
 lapBienBan(): void
 capNhatXuLy(): void
}

'========================
' 4. KE THUA
'========================
NguoiDung <|-- CuDan
NguoiDung <|-- BanQuanLy
NguoiDung <|-- BaoVe

'========================
' 5. CAC QUAN HE NGHIEP VU
'========================
CanHo \"1\" -- \"0..*\" CuDan : chứa
CanHo \"1\" -- \"0..*\" PhuongTien : quản lý
CuDan \"1\" -- \"0..*\" PhuongTien : sở hữu

PhuongTien \"1\" -- \"0..1\" GiayPhepDoXe : được cấp
KhuVucDo \"1\" -- \"0..*\" GiayPhepDoXe : áp dụng

PhuongTien \"1\" -- \"0..*\" LichSuRaVao : ghi nhận
BaoVe \"1\" -- \"0..*\" LichSuRaVao : kiểm soát

PhuongTien \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ViPham : phát sinh
BaoVe \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ViPham : lập biên bản
BanQuanLy \"1\" -- \"0..*\" ViPham : xử lý

' Gợi ý bố cục
NguoiDung -[hidden]right- CanHo
BanQuanLy -[hidden]right- CuDan
CuDan -[hidden]down- PhuongTien
PhuongTien -[hidden]right- KhuVucDo
LichSuRaVao -[hidden]right- ViPham
ViPham -[hidden]right- GiayPhepDoXe

@enduml
